role_trust.code: raw = request.headers.get("x-sentinel-role", "").strip().lower(); role = raw or ctx.default_role
role_trust.verdict: CONFIRMED — the effective role is read verbatim from the client-supplied X-Sentinel-Role header with no signature, token, or identity verification. ROLE_SCOPES (deps.py:68-77) then grants viewer/analyst/operator/admin scopes by self-declaration.
role_trust.ungated_reads: tests/integration/test_authz_matrix.py:225-229 asserts the placeholder explicitly: role 'intruder' gets HTTP 200 on GET /v1/services.
role_trust.self_declared_admin: any HTTP client can send X-Sentinel-Role: admin and receive the 'approve_changes' scope — verified by the authz matrix test design (roles parametrized as bare headers).

bind_exposure.default: host='127.0.0.1' — loopback only; non-loopback refused unless --allow-remote
bind_exposure.remote_opt_in: --allow-remote prints a warning (never silent) but proceeds; a remote bind then exposes the self-declared-role model to the network.
bind_exposure.mitigation_in_place: loopback default + explicit opt-in + loud warning; docs mark the model as Cycle-6 placeholder pending Cycle-9→10 authz.

denial_audit.evidence: deps.py:94-114 — denied requests are audit-appended best-effort; 403s never leak existence (test_denial_never_leaks_existence, test_authz_matrix.py:201).

comparison_productforge_portalapi.contrast: PortalApi uses X-Forge-Session header/forge_session cookie and returns PORTAL-SESSION on missing/invalid sessions — a real session concept; Sentinel's role header has none.

verdict: C10-F007 CONFIRMED. Authorization is client-declared only. Bounded by loopback default and documented as placeholder, so severity P1 (not P0): on the supported single-user loopback deployment a local attacker already has equal filesystem privilege to the sqlite store; the defect becomes critical only under --allow-remote exposure or multi-user deployment.
